observed: The previous EX5 stopping rule (min_delta=1e-6, patience=30) continued to record tiny validation log-loss improvements beyond 1600 epochs; the process exceeded the execution window before a complete candidate selection was written.
impact: No selection results from this attempt are used. This attempt is retained as an interrupted run. It was not resumable because the inherited fit_plain helper did not write epoch-level checkpoints; v003 replaces it with atomic resumable checkpoints.
corrective_action: A new version (v003) preregisters a validation-plateau stopping rule with identical tolerance/patience for sonde and MLP and per-fit atomic resume checkpoints.
